comparisons.peer_summary: Broadcom initiated restructuring activities in connection with the VMware Merger to integrate the acquired business and improve efficiencies, with fiscal year 2024 charges primarily consisting of $277 million in impairment charges for lease assets and property, plant, and equipment, alongside employee termination costs recognized in operating expenses. The company expects these restructuring activities to be substantially completed by the end of fiscal year 2025.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom disclosed specific 2024 restructuring plans aimed at efficiency and resource alignment, with similar completion timelines. AMD's 2024 Restructuring Plan focused on AI and enterprise markets, reducing global headcount by ~4% and expecting substantial completion by Q1 FY2025. Broadcom initiated restructuring activities in connection with the VMware Merger to integrate the business and improve efficiencies, involving employee termination costs and impairment charges, expecting substantial completion by the end of FY2025. While AMD's plan was driven by strategic realignment to growth opportunities, Broadcom's was triggered by a major merger integration.

sentences.text: In the fourth quarter of 2024, the Company implemented a restructuring plan (the 2024 Restructuring Plan) focused on driving efficiencies and aligning resources with the Company's largest growth opportunities in the AI and enterprise markets.
The Company expects actions associated with the 2024 Restructuring Plan to be substantially completed by the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 2025.
In connection with the VMware Merger, we initiated restructuring activities to integrate the acquired business, align our workforce and improve efficiencies in our operations.
We expect these restructuring activities to be substantially completed by the end of fiscal year 2025.

comparisons.peer_summary: In Q3 2024, Intel announced and initiated the 2024 Restructuring Plan to reduce costs via headcount, operating, and capital expenditure cuts, expecting total charges of $3.0 billion and substantial completion by Q4 2025, with $2.8 billion recognized cumulatively as of year-end 2024.
comparisons.comparison: AMD and Intel both disclosed new 2024 restructuring plans involving workforce reductions and expecting substantial completion in FY2025. AMD implemented its 2024 Restructuring Plan in Q4 2024, focusing on AI and enterprise markets with a 4% headcount reduction, expecting substantial completion by Q1 FY2025. Intel announced and initiated its 2024 Restructuring Plan in Q3 2024 to reduce costs via headcount and expenditure cuts, expecting substantial completion by Q4 2025. Both companies signaled a commitment to cost reduction and strategic realignment during fiscal 2024.

sentences.text: In the fourth quarter of 2024, the Company implemented a restructuring plan (the 2024 Restructuring Plan) focused on driving efficiencies and aligning resources with the Company's largest growth opportunities in the AI and enterprise markets.
The 2024 Restructuring Plan will primarily reduce global workforce by approximately 4% of headcount.
The Company expects actions associated with the 2024 Restructuring Plan to be substantially completed by the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 2025.

In the third quarter of 2024, the 2024 Restructuring Plan was announced, subsequently approved and committed to by our management team, and initiated to implement cost-reduction measures, including reductions in employee headcount, other operating expenditures, and capital expenditures.
We expect actions pursuant to the 2024 Restructuring Plan to be substantially complete by the fourth quarter of 2025, which is subject to change.
